pages.title: Pythagoras Mahjong
pages.creator: ilinskii
pages.description: Pair tiles by their mathematical value in Pythagoras Mahjong. A number can match a calculation that gives the same result, so work out the expressions before choosing a pair. Look for tiles that are free to move and see which pieces they uncover. Clear the layout by finding all the equal values.

pages.title: Flying Robot Transform Car Game
pages.creator: CodesXpirit
pages.description: Switch between a robot, a car, and a wolf in Flying Robot Transform Car Game. Explore a futuristic city and battle enemy machines, changing forms as the situation calls for it. Take on objectives in Mission Mode or roam the city in Free Mode to try the transformations on your own.

pages.title: Money Factory: Tycoon Idle Game
pages.creator: Asmodeus
pages.description: Build a money-making production line in Money Factory: Tycoon Idle Game. Start with a simple setup, then put your earnings into better equipment and new production areas. Look for places where an upgrade would help the line run more efficiently. Build up the factory as its output and profits grow.

pages.title: Magic Bubbles
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Aim colored shots at matching bubbles in Magic Bubbles. Clear groups to open up more places to shoot and see how long you can keep the board under control. Use boosters when a section is hard to reach. The game also offers weekly bonuses and a Lucky Wheel between rounds.

pages.title: Brainrot Bridge Race 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather bananas as you sprint through Brainrot Bridge Race 3D. Steer through obstacle courses and try to collect enough bananas to evolve your runner's form. Decide when a pickup is worth going after and when to keep moving past a hazard. The race gives you both the route and your evolving character to manage.

pages.title: 3D Maze Control
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Rotate the board to guide a ball in 3D Maze Control. Gravity pulls the ball downward, so changing the angle changes which passage it rolls into. Watch for aliens on the route and think ahead before turning the board. Work the ball through the maze until it reaches the goal.

pages.title: UGC Math Race
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Solve arithmetic while racing in UGC Math Race. Read each problem and head for the correct answer to stay on the course. Choose incorrectly and your runner falls. Work out the answer quickly enough to keep pace with the other racers as the next problem comes up.

pages.title: 4 Hexa
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Merge blocks that show the same number in 4 Hexa. Bring matching values together to make higher numbers and build your score. Check where the new block will be before setting up another match. Keep an eye on the space available so you can continue merging as the board changes.

pages.title: My kitties. Catworld
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Start with black, white, and ginger kittens in My kitties. Catworld. Place two cats in the house to get another kitten, and combine different colors to discover new ones. Move a kitten to the bottom of the screen to turn it into a card. Save cards in your collection and work through the tasks.

pages.title: Race It: Car Racing
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Take on a rival in a one-on-one city race in Race It: Car Racing. Swipe to drift through corners and choose when to use your boost. Watch the road and the other car so you can plan where to pass. Time the drift and boost together when you need to gain ground.

pages.title: Beauty puzzle
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Arrange falling pieces into complete lines in Beauty puzzle. Each line clears and adds to your score. The pieces come faster as you play, so decide where the next shape belongs before it reaches the stack. Keep room near the top of the board to stay in the game.

pages.title: Serious Bro
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Defend your base from alien invaders in Serious Bro. Use an M16 carbine and frag grenades to stop them as they advance through the low-poly 3D battlefield. Watch where the next group is coming from before changing targets. Use grenades when several invaders are close enough for one blast.

pages.title: Idle Factory Empire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Keep boxes moving out of your factory in Idle Factory Empire. Click factory buttons to increase production and reinvest your earnings in upgrades. Look out for bonuses from balloons and drones, and follow tips from the engineer and IT worker. Return later to collect profits that built up while you were away.

pages.title: Fire Truck Driving Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Choose from four jobs in Fire Truck Driving Simulator. Race to fires and put them out across ten levels, or accept emergencies as you explore the city. Free Mode lets you practice, and Parking Mode focuses on maneuvering the truck into position. Try each mode to handle a different part of the job.

pages.title: ASMR Nail Treatment
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Care for a patient's nails in ASMR Nail Treatment. Follow the treatment steps to address thickened fingernails, then move on to the makeover. Try nail art in different styles and choose accessories to go with it. Finish by picking an outfit to match the new look.

pages.title: Alphabet Room Maze 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect alphabet boxes with a partner in Alphabet Room Maze 3D. Search the maze and keep track of where the blue monster is roaming while you gather the boxes. Work together to cover the rooms and stay clear of the monster. The goal is to collect the letters before it catches you.

pages.title: Bomb It 8
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Take on arena challenges in Bomb It 8. Place bombs and move away before they go off while looking for ways to get past obstacles or catch an opponent. Try different characters and work through challenges that unlock bonuses. Keep an escape route in mind whenever you place a bomb.

pages.title: Billionaire Wife Dress Up Game
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Put together a luxury look in Billionaire Wife Dress Up Game. Browse clothes, hairstyles, jewelry, and accessories, then decide how you want to style the character. Try different combinations before choosing the finished outfit. Change a hairstyle or accessory to see how it changes the same set of clothes.

pages.title: Green Prickle
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Guide a ball through circles lined with thorns in Green Prickle. Watch where each spike sits and move when there's a safe way through. Keep the ball clear of the thorns as you pass from one circle to the next. Reach the finish line to complete the level.

pages.title: Tictoc Nightlife Fashion
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Follow the styling hints and take a selfie in Tictoc Nightlife Fashion. Choose an outfit and see how many likes the photo gets. Use what you earn to buy more items and try different looks. The selfie gives you a way to see how each outfit performs before you put together another one.

pages.title: Numbers
pages.creator: Ember Whirl
pages.description: Find the requested number among the tiles in Numbers. Check the prompt before you tap, then look for the next number as it changes. Choose Race mode to try for a faster time or Survival mode to see how many points you can build. The two modes test speed and accuracy in different ways.

pages.title: Battalion Commander 1917
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Lead a soldier into enemy territory in Battalion Commander 1917. Move the squad with the mouse or touch, and free prisoners so they can join your advance. Collect gold between fights and spend it on upgrades such as a heavy tank. The mission is to find and destroy a large enemy machine.

pages.title: Prison Rush
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Help a woman escape death row in Prison Rush. Use the mouse to guide her through the prison, make allies among the other prisoners, and fight guards who stand in the way. Look for chances to move farther through the prison as she works toward a way out.

pages.title: One More Loop
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tap to jump between circles in One More Loop. Wait for the right moment to move out and steer clear of red dots. Wait too long and you'll reach the center, while tapping too often sends you too far outward. See how many loops you can make in a row.

pages.title: Digger Ball 2
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Dig a tunnel that leads a ball to a well in Digger Ball 2. Use the mouse or touch to clear earth and shape a route the ball can roll down. Check the positions of the ball and well before digging. Send the ball into the well to score and finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Holeminator
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Clear obstacles from a rolling ball's path in Holeminator. Drag the hole in front of the ball so it swallows objects before the ball reaches them. Watch the road and move the hole toward the next obstruction. You protect the ball by clearing its route as it rolls forward.

pages.title: Stack Bike
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Pick up teammates during a bicycle race in Stack Bike. Hold and drag to steer toward riders waiting on the road. The riders stack onto your bike and make it faster, so look for a route that brings you past more of them. Use that speed to get ahead of the competition.

pages.title: SuperHero.io 2 Chaos Giant
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Fight other heroes in SuperHero.io 2 Chaos Giant. Earn experience to level up and take an opponent's weapon when you get the chance. Look for skill pickups that can turn you into a giant or make you invincible. Complete daily tasks and collect bonuses to unlock more heroes.

pages.title: Idle Planet Extend
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Start exploring on the Moon in Idle Planet Extend. Find resources, use machines to speed up the work, and send what you gather back to Earth. Expand the operation as more planets become available to explore. Each location gives you another place to collect resources for the journey home.

pages.title: Minecaves Noob Adventure
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Collect gems and find an exit in Minecaves Noob Adventure. Guide Steve around spikes, rivers, traps, and enemies in the dark caves. Look for weapons to help with enemies and keys to open doors. Plan the route through the cave so you can reach the gems and get out.

pages.title: Fish Love
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Bring two fish together in Fish Love. Look at how bombs, lava, and crabs are positioned before you change anything in the puzzle. Work out a safe route that lets the fish meet without bringing the hazards to them. Each scene gives you a different arrangement to solve.

pages.creator: Upjogos
pages.description: Slide numbered tiles around the board in 2048. When two tiles with the same number come together, they merge into one with twice the value. Keep some space open for new tiles as you build larger numbers. Work toward 2048 by setting up a series of smaller matches.

pages.title: Super Peaman World
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Collect peanuts and gold across three worlds in Super Peaman World. Jump onto enemies or press F to throw peanuts at them. Use WASD or the arrow keys to get around obstacles and reach pickups. The adventure takes you through 32 levels as you work through all three worlds.

pages.title: Double Driving
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Drive two cars at once in Double Driving. Tap to control them and watch both routes for approaching obstacles. Pick up coins to earn points, but keep both cars clear of hazards as you go. The run lasts only as long as you can keep either car from crashing.

pages.title: Gummy Bears Mover
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Slide whole lines of candy bears in Gummy Bears Mover. Move a row or column to line up at least three matching bears. Look at what a shift will change elsewhere on the board before you make it. Complete as many levels as you can before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Planetz: Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Planetz
pages.description: Fire planets at groups of the same kind in Planetz: Bubble Shooter. Look for a shot that clears part of the board and gives you a better angle on the planets left behind. Work through the cluster one color at a time whenever you want a short bubble-shooter round.

pages.title: Penguin Diner 2
pages.creator: 2dplay.com
pages.description: Help Penny run her own restaurant in Penguin Diner 2. Seat customers, take orders, deliver food, and clean tables when diners leave. Keep track of who's waiting when several tables need you at once. Collect tips and spend the money on restaurant upgrades or gear that helps Penny serve faster.

pages.title: Evil Spirits Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Turn over tiles and remember the pictures in Evil Spirits Hidden. Reveal two at a time and try to find identical pairs. If the pictures differ, remember where they were so you can use that information later. Clear all four boards and try to do it in as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Kill That
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Take out armed agents without hitting pedestrians in Kill That. Move to aim and tap to fire once you have a clear shot. Watch where bystanders are before pulling the trigger. The targets are armed, so line up each shot while keeping innocent people out of your line of fire.

pages.title: Wonder Pony Coloring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose a pony picture and color it in Wonder Pony Coloring. Click to apply colors to the pony and the details around it. Use a few related shades or try a different combination on each part of the drawing. Move on to another pony when you want a new picture to paint.

pages.title: Wild Slot
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Spin the reels with virtual credits in Wild Slot. See which symbols land and check the result after each spin. If you get a payout, you can take it or try the game's gamble to double it. Decide whether to keep the winnings before you spin again.

pages.title: City Ambulance Simulator
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Drive through a 3D city on emergency calls in City Ambulance Simulator. Work against the clock as you respond to accidents and bring patients to the hospital. Give yourself room to turn and park the ambulance as you approach each stop. The job combines driving quickly with putting the vehicle in the right place.

pages.title: Cartoon Childrens Day Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together scenes of Children's Day in Cartoon Childrens Day Puzzle. Pick from six pictures and solve the image with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Match details from neighboring pieces to rebuild the cartoon scene. Try a higher piece count when you want a harder version of the same picture.

pages.title: Nail Art Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Assemble pictures of decorated nails in Nail Art Puzzle. Compare colors and patterns to find pieces that belong next to each other. Join the details you recognize first, then use the surrounding image to place the harder fragments. Finish the puzzle to see the complete nail design.

pages.title: Blockz
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Click groups of matching blocks to clear them in Blockz. Look for connected colors and choose a group that helps you reach the level's goal. Some power-ups clear whole rows or columns, giving you a way to reach blocks outside the current group. Check what remains before choosing your next move.

pages.title: Falling Blocks the Tetris Game
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Clear horizontal lines in Falling Blocks the Tetris Game. Move the falling blocks so they fill the spaces left in the stack. A completed line disappears and gives you more room for the next piece. Look for placements that keep gaps from getting trapped beneath the blocks.

pages.title: Gold Miner
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Collect nuggets and jewels in Gold Miner. Aim for the treasures while leaving the gunpowder barrels alone. Look at where each object sits before you go after it, since a barrel can be close to something you need. Work through the level until you've picked up the valuables.

pages.title: Taxi Rides Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Compare two taxi scenes in Taxi Rides Difference. Look for details that have changed between the pictures and click or tap each difference you spot. The timer keeps running as you search, so check another part of the scene if you're stuck. Find the differences to move on to another level.

pages.title: Only 1 color per line
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fill the grid with colors in Only 1 color per line. Each color can appear only once on a line, so check what is already in place before filling an empty square. Use the existing colors to narrow your choices. Work through the remaining spaces until the grid follows the rule.

pages.title: Back From Wonderful Vacation
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Choose a flight-home outfit for Samantha in Back From Wonderful Vacation. After a summer trip with friends, she wants something comfortable to travel in. Use the mouse to browse clothes and put together a casual look for the journey. Try different pieces until the outfit suits her return home.

pages.title: FZ Tap Touch Run
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Tap to jump or change direction in FZ Tap Touch Run. Watch the route ahead and react before your runner reaches the end of a section. Stay on the path as it changes and see how far you can go without falling. Discover other characters as you play.

pages.title: MagicBottle
pages.creator: TinyGame
pages.description: Guide a flipping bottle to the end of the course in MagicBottle. Click to send it into the air and watch where it's going to land. Time the next flip around the space in front of you. Keep the bottle moving through the course without missing the next landing.

pages.title: Extreme ATV Quad Racer
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Race a quad bike along busy highways in Extreme ATV Quad Racer. Use WASD or the arrows to steer, Space for the handbrake, and Shift for nitro. Watch the traffic before accelerating past another vehicle. Choose from four environments, each with three modes and different tasks to complete.

pages.title: Sports Car Drift
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take a sports car out for a drift in Sports Car Drift. Use WASD to steer and Space to apply the handbrake as you approach a corner. Try to control the slide and straighten out for the next stretch. Choose from four cars and four environments to practice in.

pages.title: Sleepy Princess Resurrection
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help a princess through an emergency-room sequence in Sleepy Princess Resurrection. Follow the onscreen prompts to use the defibrillator paddles and wake her. Once she's awake, continue the game's care routine by giving her water and vitamins. Tap through each stage of the scene as the princess recovers.

pages.title: Ice Cream Memory 2
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Study the example dessert and rebuild it in Ice Cream Memory 2. Remember the details while the sample is visible, then use the mouse to choose what goes into your own serving. Match the original as closely as you can. Check the order of the ingredients before you finish.

pages.title: Airplanes Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Color one of 16 aircraft pictures in Airplanes Coloring Book. Pick from 24 colors and nine pencil sizes to work on both large areas and smaller details. Use the mouse or touch to draw. The print button gives you a way to keep a copy of the finished picture.

pages.title: Zombie Mission 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Recover data and rescue hostages in Zombie Mission 2. Work with a second player to get past traps, solve puzzles, and take out zombies. The two players have separate controls, and one can throw grenades. Help each other through all 16 levels to finish the mission.

pages.title: Toy Box Blast
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Click matching groups of toy blocks in Toy Box Blast. Look for pieces of the same color that you can clear together, then check which blocks have become reachable. Use boosters when they can help with the board's obstacles. Work through the layout and aim for the level's goal.

pages.title: Retro Brick Bust
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Break bricks and build a score in Retro Brick Bust. Move the paddle with the mouse to keep the ball in play and send it back toward the remaining bricks. Watch the angle of each rebound before moving to catch it. Keep clearing bricks as long as you can hold the ball above the paddle.

pages.title: Snowboard Hero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Snowboard down a mountain in Snowboard Hero. Steer around obstacles and collect banners for extra points when they're on a safe line. The interactive tutorial shows how to get started. Keep watching the slope so you can change direction before an obstacle gets too close.

pages.title: Heavy Combat Zombies
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take on missions against the undead in Heavy Combat Zombies. Move through each encounter and watch where the zombies are coming from before you fire. The shooter is designed for a single player, and the mission setup changes as you advance. Clear the current assignment to continue.

pages.title: Skeleton Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hold off waves of skeletons in Skeleton Defense. Start with the tutorial, then use weapons such as rifles, grenades, rockets, and Molotov cocktails. Different skeleton types approach as you play. Visit the shop to improve your weapons or unlock others for the next stretch of the defense.

pages.title: Arty Mouse Coloring Book
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Choose an Arty Mouse character and color a picture in Arty Mouse Coloring Book. Try templates featuring Scribble the dog, Stripy the cat, Dot the bear, or other friends. Switch brush sizes and colors as you work on different details. Save your picture if you'd like to keep or print it.

pages.title: The President of the USA
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Answer questions in a parody quiz in The President of the USA. Read the choices and choose the one you think is right. Correct answers make Trump's hair grow, so the changing hairstyle tracks how well you're doing. Work through the questions and see how far you can get.

pages.title: Impossible Rush
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Rotate a square to catch colored balls in Impossible Rush. Tap to turn it so the side facing the incoming ball matches its color. Watch the next ball and decide how far the square needs to turn. Keep reacting in time as you try to catch more balls in a row.

pages.title: Color Magnets
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Control two magnets through the same course in Color Magnets. One travels right side up while the other plays upside down. Watch both routes as you move so you can react to obstacles on either side. The challenge is getting both magnets through a level without losing track of one of them.

pages.title: Sea Plumber
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Repair a broken underwater pipe network in Sea Plumber. Look at the two endpoints that are still in place and find a route that connects them. Work with the pipe sections to build a continuous line across the layout. Check that each connection leads somewhere before moving on.

pages.title: Wanderers.io
pages.creator: Rezoner
pages.description: Guide a small tribe through a dangerous sandbox in Wanderers.io. Gather resources to recruit members and give them equipment. Discover technologies that improve your chances of survival, then decide how to deal with barbarians and other tribes. Build up the group as you find new things it can use.

pages.title: Bouncing Touch
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Get bouncing balls to the shore in Bouncing Touch. Watch where each one is about to fall and tap to keep it moving over the water. Pay attention when several balls need help at once. Keep them above the surface until they reach dry land.

pages.title: Shifty Gears
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help an escaped patient outrun his captors in Shifty Gears. Use his unusual powers while driving to get out of trouble and knock other cars off the road. Watch the traffic before making your next move. Keep pushing through the chase and look for a way past whatever blocks the route.

pages.title: Puzzle Painter
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Fill color patterns on a board in Puzzle Painter. Look at the colors already on the cells and decide where to extend each one. Paint the spots that complete the pattern and use quick moves to build combinations. Finish the layout and see whether your score earns three stars.

pages.title: Cartoon Candies
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Swap colorful candies to make matches in Cartoon Candies. Use the mouse to move one candy at a time and line up three or more of the same kind. Look at what drops into the spaces a match clears. Use the new arrangement to set up the next group.

pages.title: Ice Queen 2017 Trendsetter
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Dress Elsa for a fashion show in Ice Queen 2017 Trendsetter. Look through the wardrobe and choose pieces that suit the look you want the queen to present. Try different combinations before settling on an outfit. Give her a style that feels ready for the runway.
